campaign.title: Adjudicate raw near-collision counts versus beta-weighted mass

conductor_policy.monitoring: Conductor monitors task status, artifact production, scope, evidence quality, and resource allocation; it may narrow, redirect, or terminate tasks.
conductor_policy.round_close: The conductor closes this round after all required reports exist or a task is explicitly terminated, then designs the next round from the closing assessment.

numerical_purpose: reveal a pattern and motivate a conjecture, statement, or lemma
find a counterexample and falsify a conjecture
resource_policy.numerical_prohibition: Numerical evidence cannot certify or promote an asymptotic theorem.
resource_policy.literature_policy: Web literature checks are allowed and expected for strategy or method review; record exact citations and audit theorem hypotheses before use.

frozen_target.question: Which Round 9 conclusions apply to a weight-blind tuple count, which apply to the actual absolute beta-weighted mass, and which require the signed chi_4 structure?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For S_2(D;X)=sum_{1<=|h|<=H_D} beta_{h,H_D} sum_{d~D} w_D(d)e(hX/(4d)), beta_{h,H}=-Phi(|h|/(H+1)) chi_4(h) 1_{2 not divides h}/(pi h), and N=h_1d_2d_3d_4-h_2d_1d_3d_4+h_3d_1d_2d_4-h_4d_1d_2d_3, keep the raw count, absolute coefficient-weighted mass, true signed mass, and unsigned mass distinct.
quantities: weight-blind count of tuples in a specified nonzero N-band
sum of |beta_{h_1} beta_{h_2} beta_{h_3} beta_{h_4}| over that band
sum of beta_{h_1} beta_{h_2} beta_{h_3} beta_{h_4} over that band
the comparison obtained after removing chi_4 signs
forbidden_conflations: raw tuple count implies the same exponent for beta-weighted mass without coefficient summation
an unsigned or absolute estimate implies a signed estimate without a sign-preserving lemma
a finite diagnostic proves a uniform asymptotic theorem

completion_criteria: Each of the four frozen quantities has an exact normalization and scale statement.
Any claimed X^(3/8) crossover is traced through tuple counting and beta coefficient summation separately.
The D=X^(1/2) endpoint is checked explicitly.
The hostile audit either constructs a compatible lower-bound family or proves why the known UNC, TS, and W-1 controls do not transfer.
The finite diagnostic is independently reproducible and remains diagnostic_only.
Normalization, counting, coefficient summation, and endpoint seams are reviewed before any graph patch.
No task promotes M9, M9-M2, or the final Gauss circle target.

tasks.target: Derive from the frozen definitions the strongest justified upper bound for the beta-weighted absolute mass in a nonzero near-collision band. Show every lift, harmonic sum, and truncation factor and state whether an X^(3/8) transition remains.

Attack both candidate conclusions. Search for a compatible weighted lower-bound family or a missing lift, multiplicity, beta, or truncation factor. Determine exactly which known UNC, TS, and W-1 obstruction applies to each frozen quantity.

Implement exact finite comparisons of raw count, 1/|h|-weighted absolute mass, true beta-signed mass, and unsigned beta mass across representative dyadic scales, including the X^(1/2) endpoint. Seek falsification and normalization mistakes, not asymptotic confirmation.

review_seams.requirement: Check beta, parity, two-sided frequencies, dyadic support, and band definitions.
Check tuple parametrization, gcd conditions, lift multiplicities, degeneracies, and overlap.
Check every harmonic sum and the passage from raw count to beta-weighted mass.
Check constants and exponents uniformly through D=X^(1/2).

campaign.promotion_policy: Coordinator may propose only a narrowly scoped graph patch after every validation seam is green; computations remain diagnostic_only.
